Effects of high-dose alacepril on the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system and autonomic nervous system function in healthy dogs. This study investigated the effects of low-dose and high-dose alacepril on the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS) and autonomic nervous system in healthy dogs. Six Beagle dogs received low-dose (2.0 mg/kg/day) or high-dose (6.0 mg/kg/day) alacepril for 4 weeks.
